steps: Argparse accepts exactly the three fixed group names and requires a group. No user command text is evaluated.
Each listed child executes with sys.executable and an absolute script path from the project root, with no omitted required arguments.
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS and OMP_NUM_THREADS are fixed to1; PYTHONOPTIMIZE is removed so assertion-based certificates remain active.
Before and after source hashes and full stdout/stderr logs are retained per child. Nonzero exit or source change marks that child failed.
The final complete flag records that execution ended; all_passed and process exit are the success signals. A complete=true receipt alone does not certify anything.

The three existing completed group receipts match every current GROUPS member, invocation, source hash and saved log. This verifies the wrapper by composition with the completed child executions; it does not repeat the expensive certificates or replace their mathematical review.
scope: Command orchestration and exact correspondence of existing full group executions, separate from analytic proof review.
